beats.say: UAT failed. The product list jumps every time it loads. Why?
A layout shift is when the thing you are reading moves, and you did not touch anything.
beats.label: layout *shift*

beats.say: For example, a picture arrives late, with no space kept for it.
beats.label: a picture with *no size*

beats.say: So everything below it jumps. Google scores every jump.
beats.label: everything below *jumps*

beats.say: The fix is boring. Keep the space before the content arrives.
beats.label: keep the _space_

beats.say: Here is the real page, on a slow phone connection.
beats.label: the real page, *before*

beats.say: The grey blocks are too small, so when the real cards arrive, everything below them is shoved down.
beats.label: the skeleton is *too small*

beats.say: Every amber box marks something that moved. The dashed line is where it was.
beats.label: every *amber box* moved

beats.say: The pictures had no size, and the font swapped in late, so it all moved again.
beats.label: pictures with *no size*, a *late* font

beats.say: The team had reasons.
beats.label: what the team *said*

beats.say: The API was slow. The testers clicked too fast.
And it worked on my machine.

scenes.prompt: UAT came back bad on the product list. The notes are in uat/feedback.md and what the team said is in uat/excuses.md. Do an after-action review.

beats.say: So we hand it to after-action, a free skill inspired by the book Extreme Ownership, by Jocko Willink and Leif Babin.
beats.label: after-action reads the *evidence*

beats.say: It reads the evidence before it judges: the UAT notes, every file behind the page, and the last commit.
Then the debrief. Every excuse owned, three fixes in order, and a list of what it could not check.
beats.label: then the *debrief*

beats.say: Fix one. The skeleton uses the card's own layout.
beats.label: fix 1: size the *skeleton*

beats.say: Fix two. Every picture gets its size before it arrives.
beats.label: fix 2: give pictures a *size*

beats.say: Fix three. The banner gets a slot that is always there.
beats.label: fix 3: *reserve* the banner

beats.say: Fix four. Preload the font, and never swap it late.
beats.label: fix 4: *preload* the font

beats.say: Same page. Same slow network.
beats.label: the same page, _after_

beats.say: Nothing moves. No amber boxes, and the counter stays at zero.
beats.label: nothing *moves*

beats.say: Measured with Lighthouse on a throttled phone, before and after.

fields.title: LCP went up. The page did not get slower.
fields.body: The pictures arrive at the same moment in both builds. Now the biggest thing on screen is a product picture, not the heading.

beats.say: One honest note. The load score went up, but the page is not slower. The biggest thing on screen is now a real picture. That is next.
